certification.name: Certified Blue Teamer
certification.description: Four-hour practical exam in which candidates investigate a multi-stage intrusion in a Windows Active Directory enterprise and correlate artifacts across the attack lifecycle. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.
certification.currency_note: Vendor lists GBP only (GBP 250); converted at 1.3423 USD/GBP (ECB reference rate, 2026-11-10); frequent promotional discounts; one free retake included
